That broke the adapter we received — engineering is triaging but estimates the fix will take at least two full sprints given other priorities.

This obviously blocks our data ingest and the demo next Tuesday. Given the delay, could Redwood provide a small sandbox credit top-up (we estimate ~150k tokens for replays and testing) and extend the trial window by two weeks? If we can get that runway we will continue the POC and aim to keep to the original success criteria once the adapter is updated.

I attached the trace we hit and the adapter auth spec for reference.

Appreciate any help,
